title: Bug: frr-mgmt-framework YANG model issues
author: bhouse-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

The YANG models for frr-mgmt-framework have various issues where they do not match the implementation within the frr-mgmt-framework templates or frrcfgd, or are missing valid values that are needed.  This means when using something like `config replace` that mandates valid YANG form, frr-mgmt-framework cannot be used if needing these features.

| description | PR |
|------------|----|
| Prefix list does not take sequenceid | https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/22888 |
| Route map should allow match on Loopback interfaces | https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/22889 |
| Prefix set requires `mode` | https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/22887 |

### Steps to Reproduce

Attempt to perform yang validation on any of the listed issues.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Yang models should match implementation.

linkedPullRequests.title: Route Policy PREFIX list implementation issues related to `sequence_number`
linkedPullRequests.author: bhouse-nexthop
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it

The sequence_number is used as a key in the yang model and is therefore mandatory, however the implementation does not expect a sequence id at all and just uses the order in which the prefixes appear. 

The sequence_number however may be a desirable feature so should be honored if we have it, but for compatibility with any existing users (who clearly are not using YANG validation), it must be removed from the yang list model as a key.

This also being a key also does not align with the HLD: https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/master/doc/mgmt/SONiC_Design_Doc_Unified_FRR_Mgmt_Interface.md#321121-prefix

If passing value as YANG requires, the jinja2 renderer and frrcfgd both fail.

This affects unified mode with frr_mgmt_framework_config.

Links to proof this change is required:

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/0ad420e02c50d7ad140d9e2e86c5a7550cf4fda5/src/sonic-frr-mgmt-framework/frrcfgd/frrcfgd.py#L2224-L2234

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/0ad420e02c50d7ad140d9e2e86c5a7550cf4fda5/src/sonic-frr-mgmt-framework/templates/bgpd/bgpd.conf.db.pref_list.j2#L10-L22

##### Work item tracking

#### How I did it

This updates the YANG model to remove the `sequence_number` as a key, adds a uniqueness `must` clause validation for the `sequence_number`. Tests are also implemented to confirm behavior. frr-mgmt-framework has been expanded to include support for the `sequence_number` as an optional parameter.

#### How to verify it

Run test cases herein.

linkedPullRequests.title: YANG: PREFIX_SET entries require `mode` field
linkedPullRequests.author: bhouse-nexthop
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it

Currently `mode` is not marked as a mandatory field nor has a default value, however without it the FRR configuration is not rendered properly.

This affects unified mode with frr_mgmt_framework_config.

Links to implementation proving YANG model needs update:

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/0ad420e02c50d7ad140d9e2e86c5a7550cf4fda5/src/sonic-frr-mgmt-framework/templates/bgpd/bgpd.conf.db.route_map.j2#L33

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/0ad420e02c50d7ad140d9e2e86c5a7550cf4fda5/src/sonic-frr-mgmt-framework/frrcfgd/frrcfgd.py#L2219-L2223
